sounds.author: Jonathon Jongsma
sounds.description: :Calls from an agitated adult turkey in response to human intruder. There were a family group of turkeys (perhaps 8-10 young?) that I accidentally disturbed on the wooded hillside next to my campsite. The adults called nervously for a while before flying toward me (@ 0:35) and landing in a tree perhaps 5 meters up and 5 meters away from me while continuously calling. It eventually flew off after the rest of the group had made it safely away down the hill. Some high-pitched calls from the young can also be heard. Clear and cool morning. bird-seen:yes playback-used:no Common name: Wild Turkey Type: call Genus: Meleagris Species: gallopavo Location: Afton State Park, Washington County, Minnesota Country: United States Elevation: 240 m

sourceNotes: Table to Farm? project: ten candidates in each of seven categories.
No candidate is approved. The owner decides each recording in Sound Scrubber.
Source audio downloaded and decoded; FSD50K entries checked against archive CRC and byte count; all SHA256 hashes distinct.
AI-designed SFXMint effects are labeled separately from source recordings.
Music auditions stop after eight seconds; approval preserves and downloads the full source recording. Individual artist/license credits are retained.
This batch requests an actual device-file download on each explicit owner approval.
